get_vae_experiment_config: get the default VAE experiment configuration as a ConfigDict with all hyperparameters set
customize_vae_optimization: customize the VAE optimization step sizes for VI, AFT, CRAFT, and SNF algorithms
configure_vae_mcmc: configure MCMC sampling parameters including HMC, NUTS, and slice step settings for VAE
set_vae_initial_distribution: set the initial distribution to MultivariateNormal with configurable mean and diagonal covariance
set_vae_target_distribution: set the final target distribution to AutoEncoderLikelihood with a VAE pickle file path
